title: Vanillas+
description: This isn't just another Vanilla+ Pack
body: **_Vanillas+_** includes **over 130 carefully selected mods**. None of them alter core gameplay mechanics or progression. The goal is simple: deliver a smooth, modern Vanilla experience that feels familiar — just **faster**, **cleaner**, and **more stable**. With a full performance-focused mod stack, **_Vanillas+_** is designed to run at **well over 100 FPS** on most systems.
